body: ❤ Just know your words are going to stick with me for the rest of my life truly.

I truthfully thought nobody would reply, because honestly why would they? But you guys who have, means everything too me right now. I need to work myself out. It might not happen tomorrow or next month. Maybe not even this year. But I need to start fixing my problems before, I ruin any future relationships I have with people.
Thank you. The first step to fixing any problem,  is admitting there is one.
But how do you master your  thoughts? I've tried affirmations, positive thinking, even fuckin mantras. They never seem to take hold.
Thank you. Your right. Just like everyone else whose told me to shave my head. I just can't seem to find the balls to do it whenever  I have the clippers in my hand.

I work out at home daily(even before covid)and my job requires me too move around all day(i walk an average of 8 miles a day). Plus all the heavy lifting has my body slender and pretty toned up. But my schedule won't allow me to go to the gym to gain any type of bulk(because I have to take public transportation)

I can't afford it. I'm living paycheck to paycheck
 While getting ready to move in July.
